debian_layer.important_limit: This exact map binds every recorded Free and Pro binary name/version to its Dagric release commit or Debian source package/version, archived .dsc SHA-256, and the source-file SHA-256 values carried by that .dsc.
retrieval_procedure: Find the exact binary name and version under the matching Free or Pro edition in this map.
Download the mapped .dsc from Debian Snapshot and verify its recorded SHA-256.
Download every source file listed for that entry and verify the SHA-256 recorded by the .dsc.
For a Dagric-authored package, use the commit-pinned Dagric source archive and verify its recorded SHA-256.
debian_layer.request_note: The exact release mapping is published in this record. Contact Dagric support for help obtaining the corresponding source for a named image and package.

required_before_another_binary_release: A generated mapping that matches every normalized Free and Pro binary name/version exactly once, with no missing, duplicate, or extra entries.

Every mapping entry must carry the exact source name/version plus an official Debian archive/snapshot locator or .dsc URL and a .dsc SHA-256; Dagric packages use the release-pinned source archive and its SHA-256.
A release check that rejects a missing, stale, or incomplete mapping before either ISO is published or sold.
